name: Midnight Roots | 100mg Full Moon Chocolate | Apple Fritter (1:1:1 THC:CBD:CBG)
description: Take a moment to savor the warm, nostalgic bliss of our Apple Fritter Full Moon, a perfect balance of crisp apple sweetness, real cinnamon spice, and the creamy richness of a white chocolate base. More than a delicious treat, this recipe shines with a carefully crafted 1:1:1 ratio of THC, CBD, and CBG - making it a powerhouse of flavor and full-spectrum benefits. Known for its uplifting and focus-enhancing properties, CBG makes this Full Moon an ideal companion for daytime adventures or moments of creativity. Just like everything we create at Midnight Roots, this flavor is a tribute to our commitment to excellence and our deep roots in the cannabis community. From our family to yours, the Apple Fritter Full Moon is more than a product - it’s a reflection of our passion, our dedication to quality, and our shared journey toward wellness and joy.
